name: cosign
notes: Unmodified upstream release binary (a Go executable). It verifies the signature of the runner image (docs/runner.md, "Updates"): the installer (runner/install/install.sh) and the runner image (runner/Dockerfile.factory-runner) take it from the release asset below and accept it only when its SHA-256 is the pinned one. The digest is the one GitHub shows for the asset (and the one in the release's cosign_checksums.txt). The asset is the executable itself, so the archive and the executable digests are the same. Another platform needs its own asset and digests here; never reuse this one.
